prediction.label: AFIB
prediction.description: Atrial fibrillation - irregularly irregular rhythm with absent P waves.

findings.name: Heart Rate
findings.explanation: Resting heart rate derived from R-peak intervals.

findings.name: Rr Mean
findings.explanation: Mean R-R interval; the reciprocal of heart rate.

findings.name: Rr Sd
findings.explanation: R-R variability; elevated values suggest arrhythmia.

findings.name: Rr Cv
findings.explanation: Coefficient of variation of R-R intervals (normalised irregularity).

findings.name: Rmssd
findings.explanation: Root mean square of successive R-R differences (short-term HRV).

findings.name: Pnn50
findings.explanation: Percentage of successive R-R intervals differing by more than 50 ms.

findings.name: Lf Hf
findings.explanation: Low-frequency to high-frequency power ratio of the HRV spectrum. Not measurable in this recording.

findings.name: Qrs Duration
findings.explanation: QRS complex duration; widening indicates bundle branch block or ventricular origin.

findings.name: St Deviation
findings.explanation: ST segment deviation from the isoelectric line.

findings.name: T Amplitude
findings.explanation: T-wave amplitude on the primary lead.

findings.name: R Amplitude
findings.explanation: R-wave amplitude; low values can indicate myocardial ischaemia.

findings.name: Pvc Fraction
findings.explanation: Fraction of detected beats classified as premature ventricular complexes.

findings.name: Rr Irregularity
findings.explanation: Poincare-style irregularity of the R-R series.

findings.name: Signal Quality
findings.explanation: Signal quality index derived from the noise-to-signal ratio.

explainability.summary: The prediction 'AFIB' was driven mainly by Pnn50, Rr Cv, Rr Irregularity. The model assigned 95.9% confidence to this class.

recommendations: Rhythm is irregularly irregular - confirm atrial fibrillation with a 12-lead ECG.
Check rate control, thromboembolic risk (CHA2DS2-VASc) and anticoagulation eligibility.
Signal quality is limited - repeat the recording with better electrode contact before acting.
Findings must be interpreted by a qualified clinician against the full patient record.
